authority: repository-owned lifecycle decision; observed provider state remains evidence-bound
rules: Lifecycle state controls execution eligibility across workflows, provider matrices, quota views, and generated catalogs.
Historical quota and deployment records remain available as evidence after provider retirement.
A provider capability, account connection, quota record, and deployed workload remain separate facts.
Serverless functions and VMs are workload classes; each provider must prove its deployed product and workload identity.
A generated inventory may discover retired workflows while preserving their retired classification.
